rachel-peopleops: FYI we have Olga Petrova visiting Thu morning. Flight lands 07:05, interview loop 09:30-12:30. She requested scent-free room, early badge pickup, and a loaner laptop. Can facilities confirm? tagging @facilities-bot

facilities-bot: Quiet Room C available and held from 07:15-13:00. We can prepare a loaner laptop (RL-STD-2025) and leave credentials in sealed envelope at security. Please submit visitor form: https://redwood.internal/forms/visitor-ops with full name and ETA.

omar-recruiter: Also requested a nut-free boxed lunch and all-day parking. I can DM travel details if needed.

sam-ops: Reserving Quiet Room C, desk 2 with external monitor and headset. Badge will be printed and held. Parking single-use QR: PARK-OLGA-9F3. I will post the reception check-in link the morning of.

rachel-peopleops: Added scent-free note to calendar invite and updated event start to 09:30. Security badge pickup instructions to candidate: bring passport or driver's license; pickup at security 07:50, mention code BADGE-OLGA-2076. Ordering nut-free lunch.

nico-eng: I can move my interview to 10:00 if that helps.

olga-p: Thank you everyone, appreciate the accommodations. See you Thu.

sam-ops: Will ping this thread at 07:10 on Thu to confirm badge and laptop ready.

rachel-peopleops: Great, thanks all.
